thread:
incident-bot: Pager: HIGH severity — container crashloop detected on pool-prod-7/node-az3 (runtime:v2.4). Crash reason: segfault (SIGSEGV). Auto-retries exhausted. Paging oncall now.

Maria (oncall): I’m on it. Seen the alerts: 3 nodes in pool-prod-7 flapping, most recent from node-az3. Any customer reports?

Priya - Support: We have 2 customers reporting 504s in the last 6m (acct: vidstream, acct: docspro). CS is triaging and sent workaround (retry/backoff) to customers.

Maria (oncall): Ok blocking steps: 1) cordon node-az3, 2) scale down affected pool to drain, 3) route traffic to fallback pool-dedicated-1. Who can gather coredump + kernel logs?

Samir (infra): I’ll take coredump. Running: `kubectl -n runtime exec -it pod/runtime-xyz -- bash` then `coredumpctl dump > /tmp/dump.sigsegv` if systemd coredumps present. If not, grabbing docker container logs + GDB backtrace.

Alice Chen: Adding quick telemetry: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/pool/pool-prod-7?orgId=1 — latency and OOM_killer spikes. I see memory growth correlated with long sequences (serving > 1k tokens) just before crash.

Samir (infra): Getting logs now. Snippet from container stderr: ```
[2026-03-15T02:04:12Z] runtime: kv_cache->get: idx=512
[2026-03-15T02:04:12Z] FATAL: Unexpected nullptr deref at src/attention/cache.cpp:214
#0  0x7fb2a1b2a9 in __gnu_cxx::(anonymous namespace)::whatever()
#1  0x7fa3c4f3b2 runtime::forward_attention
#2  0x7fa3c4f7d0 model::infer_loop
#3  0x7fa3c44c11 main
Segmentation fault (core dumped)
```

Jules - SRE: That stack looks like our custom KV cache path in the new fused-attention kernel. Was this a recent rollout?

Maria (oncall): Yes — we rolled fused-attn v2.4 to pool-prod-7 ~01:30 UTC as a canary. Can that explain the crash?

Alice Chen: We had one canary pod with same binary. Need to check binary hash. `sha256sum /opt/runtime/bin/runtime` on crashed pod vs release artifact.

Samir (infra): Binary matches release artifact `v2.4-rc3` — same as canary. Reproducing locally on repro node with same request trace. I triggered a long sequence request and gdb shows invalid deref in AttentionCache::get when seq_len > 2048.

Maria (oncall): Good find. So it's likely a boundary condition introduced by fused-attn v2.4. Mitigation options: 1) Rollback runtime to v2.3 for pool-prod-7, 2) Patch runtime quickly to guard the null, 3) Use routing policy to send long requests to fallback model variant (non-fused).

Jules - SRE: Rollback looks fastest to restore capacity. We should also cordon node-az3 to stop noisy restarts.

Samir (infra): Rolling rollback job: `kubectl -n runtime set image deploy/runtime-pool-prod-7 runtime=registry.redwood/runtime:v2.3 --record` starting now. Will monitor rollout.

incident-bot: Automated action: rollback job started by Samir. Notifying oncall channel and creating incident ticket #INC-20260315-3789.

Priya - Support: CS notes: vidstream experiencing 15% error rate for embed calls, docspro 8% on chat. Both on managed hosted tier. Communicated ETA ~20m while rollback completes.

Alice Chen: While rollback runs, let's block long requests at the ingress: set header-based rate limit to reject seq>1024. Patch is in gateway: `gatewayctl set-filter pool-prod-7 --max-seq 1024`. I can apply if folks agree.

Maria (oncall): Do it. We want to limit blast radius. Also cordon node-az3: `kubectl cordon node-az3` and `kubectl drain node-az3 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data` (doing drain with caution).

Samir (infra): Node cordoned and draining now. Rollback progressing: 3/5 pods updated to v2.3, 5/5 pods in pool-prod-7 are now stable and Ready=5. Error rate falling on Grafana.

Alice Chen: Metrics: request errors for pool-prod-7 dropped from 12% -> 2% in 7m. Latency back to normal. CS updated customers with rollback completion.

Jules - SRE: Ok postmortem actions: capture failing request traces and minimal repro, add assertion in AttentionCache::get, add unit test for seq boundary, and schedule a canary run with synthetic long sequences. Also audit release automation to require long-seq smoke test.

Samir (infra): Collected core dump and pushed it to s3: s3://redwood-telemetry/incidents/3789012345/dumps/dump.sigsegv (internal link) with gdb bt: ```
#0  AttentionCache::get (this=0x0, idx=512) at src/attention/cache.cpp:214
#1  fused_attention_forward
#2  model_infer_loop
#3  start_worker
```

Priya - Support: Customers acknowledged rollback. CS will follow up with remediation notes and offer credits if SLA hit confirmed. They requested ETA for fix — ETA for patched runtime?

Maria (oncall): Devs estimate ~1 day to patch + tests. For now, keep routing long requests to fallback variant and block seq > 1024 on pool-prod-7 until patch closes.

Alice Chen: Creating follow-up ticket in the repo: `INF-4521` with stack, dump, and repro. Also adding postmortem template items: customer impact, timeline, root cause (fused-attn boundary bug), remediation (patch + tests), and rollout controls.

incident-bot: Incident state: mitigated (rollback applied). Incident coordinator: Maria (oncall). Severity downgraded to MEDIUM.

Jules - SRE: I’ll take ownership of the postmortem write-up. Handoff to night oncall at 23:00 UTC: @night-oncall please monitor pools and verify no regressions.

Maria (oncall): Handoff notes: rollback applied, node-az3 cordoned/drained, core dump saved, customers notified, INF-4521 opened. If repeat crashes show up, escalate to Eng-ML (fused-attn owners).

Samir (infra): Left a follow-up playbook entry: always run seq-length smoke test for fused-attn before rollout. Pushing to infra runbook.

Priya - Support: I’ll follow up with customers and track SLA impact.

Alice Chen: Final note — observed secondary metric: small bump in GPU memory fragmentation before crash. Will correlate with fused kernels memory path.

Maria (oncall): Thanks all. Closing live pager thread. Reopen here if something recurs. :thumbsup:
